network.title: Network
network.subtitle: Establish a direct, encrypted link to a peer over the internet.
network.footer: Exchange the offer/answer blobs out of band, then press Connect on both ends. Once connected, live RTT, throughput and the packet log appear on the <1>Diagnostics</1> page.

nodeIdentity.label: This node · fingerprint
nodeIdentity.fingerprintTitle: A short fingerprint for voice/chat verification. To connect, share your full public key (Copy public key) — that is the authoritative identifier.
nodeIdentity.copyButtonTitle: Copy the full public key — the authoritative identifier to share with a peer

peerConnection.heading: Peer Connection · manual signaling
peerConnection.connectingTitle: Handshake in progress (≤8s). Click to cancel.
peerConnection.connectTitleNoPeer: Exchange an offer/answer with a peer first
peerConnection.connectTitleRunning: Stop the telemetry-source session before connecting to a peer
peerConnection.connectTitleReady: Punch through to the peer and establish the encrypted link
peerConnection.peerInputPlaceholder: Paste your peer's offer or answer blob…
peerConnection.sendAnswerBack: Send this answer back to your peer:

diagnostics.title: Diagnostics
diagnostics.subtitle: Live engine telemetry — {{mode}}.
diagnostics.elevationDefaultMessage: Administrator privileges are required to create the virtual network adapter.
diagnostics.statFecTitle: Packets rebuilt from parity instead of being lost — cumulative for this connection
diagnostics.statBlockedTitle: Packets the split-tunnel policy refused, in either direction — cumulative for this connection
diagnostics.noPacketsYet: No packets yet. Press Start, or connect to a peer on the Network page.

settings.title: Settings
settings.connectionSubtitle: Applied the next time you press Connect — not to an already-live link.
settings.forwardBroadcastTitle: Broadcast traffic (e.g. LAN game discovery) into the tunnel
settings.forwardMulticastTitle: Multicast traffic (e.g. mDNS discovery) into the tunnel
settings.fecRedundancySubtitle: Recovers up to r lost packets per group of 8, at more bandwidth.
settings.expertModeTitle: Show advanced settings (split-tunnel forwarding, FEC redundancy). Off by default; hidden settings stay in effect either way.
